title: ConnectWise investigating potential Cloud Backup Breach
description: ConnectWise is investigating unauthorized access attempts targeting its Cloud Backup platform, formerly known as SkyKick. The company has initiated incident response and containment measures but has not confirmed any successful data access. Third-party intelligence suggests possible compromise and lateral movement into live Office 365 environments of MSP customers. Indicators of suspicious activity include specific IP addresses and user agents. The investigation is ongoing, and no confirmed data breach has been reported yet.

aiSummary: ConnectWise reported an ongoing investigation into suspicious authentication activity within its Cloud Backup environment. While no confirmed data access has been established, third-party sources allege that threat actors may have gained access and pivoted to customers' live Office 365 environments, potentially exposing backup data including EntraID. ConnectWise has deployed containment measures and shared indicators of compromise such as source IP 144.172.64.128 and user agents 'Python-urllib/3.12' and 'python-requests/2.31' to aid monitoring. The incident response is active, and further details are pending.
aiImpact: If the unauthorized access is confirmed, it could lead to exposure of sensitive backup data for MSP customers, including Office 365 and EntraID information. This could compromise customer environments and data integrity. Currently, there is no confirmed evidence of data access or breach, but the potential impact is significant given the nature of the data involved.
